### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **27** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`  _(via TranslationDataSchema (symbol, a top-level const), globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema), metadataForms (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY), settingsCommon (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY))_
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema), metadataForms (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY), settingsCommon (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class), globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **154** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json abebc4e14d43d8518e2dade88eeaa07e536c3b17` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8430d5827f13133cd1ffef1f5bf68158838956e9` — the merge of head `ac2bcb0ba728e477f90fbe1a1ca227a4154d2b29` into base `abebc4e14d43d8518e2dade88eeaa07e536c3b17`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8430d5827f13133cd1ffef1f5bf68158838956e9 && git checkout 8430d5827f13133cd1ffef1f5bf68158838956e9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin abebc4e14d43d8518e2dade88eeaa07e536c3b17 ac2bcb0ba728e477f90fbe1a1ca227a4154d2b29 && git checkout -B drift-repro abebc4e14d43d8518e2dade88eeaa07e536c3b17 && git merge --no-ff ac2bcb0ba728e477f90fbe1a1ca227a4154d2b29

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json abebc4e14d43d8518e2dade88eeaa07e536c3b17
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs abebc4e14d43d8518e2dade88eeaa07e536c3b17` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ac2bcb0ba728e477f90fbe1a1ca227a4154d2b29`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts + packages/core/src/fallbacks/authored-translation-sync.ts (the one runtime reader of `LEGACY_OBJECT_FIRST_KEYS`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (`getPackagedReportBase`, `packagedArtifactBase`), packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts (`PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS`, `packagedObjectBaseOf`, `translateMetaList`), packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts (`walkReports`, `pushOptional`), packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts (the `report` bucket), packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts (`Universe.reports`, `namedItemGroups`), packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts (`ReportSchema.label` / `.description` are `I18nLabelSchema`), the generated artifacts (api-surface, authorable-surface, export-origins, liveness/translation.json and its state-counts, the strictness-ledger count), docs/adr/0029 D9.2a and docs/adr/0126 section 3, the precedent commit 47af3dde (#25701), .changeset/25788-translation-reports.md, and the tests that pin each claim (spec i18n-report.test.ts, cli i18n-report-walk.test.ts, lint validate-translation-references.test.ts, rest meta-dashboard-view-i18n-explicit-override.test.ts section 4, runtime meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts, objectql protocol-packaged-report-base.test.ts). The rest of the diff (docs prose, the three example bundles, the walk-parity fixture) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

### ① Derived judgments

**The `reports` group — right.** `appTranslationDataShape()` gains `reports: z.record(name, strictObject({ label?, description? }))`, inserted after `datasets` and before `pages`, byte-for-byte the shape of the `positions` group the precedent added (same `strictObject` kit, same `TRANSLATION_HISTORY`, same `aliases: { name: 'label', title: 'label' }`). Because the three doors (`TranslationDataSchema`, `PlatformTranslationDataSchema`, `TranslationItemSchema`) spread that one shape, all three accept the group with no per-door edit, and each door's alias map gained `report: 'reports'`. The thirteen-to-fourteen count moved in every prose site that states it (`PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY`, `ITEM_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY`, the three schema doc blocks, i18n-standard.mdx) and the group order in those messages matches the shape order. `authorable-surface` carries `reports` on all three types; `api-surface` and `export-origins` carry `ReportLike` and `translateReport`; the liveness ledger seeds `translation/reports` LIVE with drilled `label` / `description` children and names the reader, the datasets precedent. The face stops at the two strings the report itself authors, which is what the card asks for.

**Its readers — right, each verified in the cited code.**
- `translateReport` (i18n-resolver.ts): registered in `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`; `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` is derived from that table and `@objectstack/rest` reads it, so `GET /meta/report` list and item localize with no rest edit for the dispatch half (the runtime census test moves the reference on both reads). Lookup walks `localeChain(opts)` through `pickData(bundle, code)?.reports?.[name]?.[attr]` and accepts only a non-empty string, as `lookupDashboardAttr` does. Returns the same reference when nothing matched, when the bundle is absent, or when the document has no string `name`. An inline locale-map `label` the bundle does not address is left intact (test pins it).
- `walkReports` (cli): reads `config.reports[]`, emits `reports.NAME.label` / `.description` through `pushOptional`, so an unwritten description is recorded without an inline and never demanded (`authoredEvidence`). The coverage bucket `report` has its `COVERAGE_SOURCE`, `SOURCE_NOUN` and `SOURCE_SURFACE` rows, so a gap reports as `i18n/missing-report`, not folded into `dashboard`. The walk-parity fixture authors one report so `check:i18n-walk-parity` sees the group walked.
- `translation-target-unknown` (lint): `Universe.reports = namesOf('reports')`, which already folds sibling packages' declarations (the `concat` disposition the module doc cites), and the `reports` row joined the renamed `namedItemGroups` loop beside positions and permissions, same `error` severity, same nearest-name hint. The explanation text names the leg.

**Removing `reports` from `LEGACY_OBJECT_FIRST_KEYS` — verified, and required rather than optional.** The one runtime reader is `packages/core/src/fallbacks/authored-translation-sync.ts` at the `legacyKeys` filter: a stored `translation` row carrying ANY listed key is warned about and `continue`d, so a declared group left on the list would parse clean in a file and never load from a Studio-authored row. The type `Record of LegacyObjectFirstKey` on `TRANSLATION_KEY_GUIDANCE` forces the guidance entry out with it. Every other mention of either symbol in the tree is the exported const's name (api-surface, export-list.test.ts, CHANGELOG), not a reader. objectui: `git grep` of both symbols over the sibling clone at `cd70b78` (fifteen commits behind the pinned `b41ed7f6`, which only added two `CATEGORY_DEFS` rows) returns no hits, agreeing with the dev's measurement at `699156a`. Consequence of the removal, stated correctly in the new doc comment: a pre-#3778 row carrying only a legacy-shaped `reports` value (measured footprint zero) now passes through `applyConversionsToStoredItem` and merges; a non-object value under `reports.NAME` resolves to nothing in `lookupReportAttr`, so nothing renders from it and nothing regresses.

**The Regime O yield (ADR-0029 D9.2a) — verified against both ADRs.** ADR-0126 section 3 lists Regime O as exactly `view, dashboard, report, translation, email_template`, so a report IS overlay-editable and a translator that ignored the packaged base would replace an org's re-authored label with the catalog string, the #20680 class. ADR-0029 D9.2a rules "an explicit override beats a packaged default" by comparison-based provenance, the same predicate the i18n catalog uses (#8284), compared against the packaged owner alone. The diff honours all three clauses: `translateReport` calls the one shared `valueOverridesPackagedBase(base, key, value)`, never a second copy; `getPackagedReportBase` goes through `packagedArtifactBase`, whose body is `lookupArtifactItem` and nothing wider, so only a `_packageId`-marked item answers and an overlay hydrated under the plain registry key never does (the objectql test proves the trap is live and the base does not move); `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` gained the `report` row so `translateMetaList` and the item twin resolve the protocol once per request and hand `packagedObjectBaseOf(p, 'report', item.name)` to the translator. The rest section-4 matrix pins the three facts (edit served as written, untouched description still translated, reset restores the shipped label translated) over item and list reads, two callers and two locales. One conservative edge, identical to the dashboard rule and therefore right: a description the packaged report never declared but the served document carries counts as diverged and is left untranslated.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: added` on the PR body and in the changeset, line-initial, each once. Kind `added` takes at least `minor` on every published package the diff moves: `.changeset/25788-translation-reports.md` declares `minor` on `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/rest`, which are exactly the five packages with a non-test source change (`packages/runtime` and `packages/objectql` move test files only, publish nothing, owe nothing). No `(narrowing)` arm, no `!`, no tombstone owed (nothing authorable is removed: the retired-dialect `reports` key becomes a declared group, so an author who wrote it is now accepted rather than refused differently). `Check Changeset` is green on the head. The precedent spelled `yes (widening)`; the arm is optional under the rule, so the bare `yes` reads the same. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Deviation from the precedent's package set (metadata-protocol + rest) — accepted.** Inside the claim's "runtime meta translation path"; ADR-0126 makes it a requirement, not a widening of scope: positions and permission sets were not Regime O, a report is. One accessor and one table row, each the twin of an existing dashboard row, each pinned by a test.
2. **Deviation from the precedent's list (the `LEGACY_OBJECT_FIRST_KEYS` removal) — accepted**, verified in ① as the only correct resolution of the name collision; the PM assumption on the order is measured and decided.
3. **A joined report's `blocks[].label` — should be a card, not a blocker.** `ui/report.zod.ts` types a block's `label` as `I18nLabelSchema`, so an inline locale map works today, but the bundle has no key and `os i18n check` cannot see the gap; the showcase example demonstrates the symptom (`showcase_task_overview`: translated heading over authored block labels). That is filing gate ① with a named landing site (`translateReport` plus `walkReports`, the shape this PR just built), the sibling relation #25788 had to #25652. Recommend the seat files it as a small follow-up on the spec lane (dedupe words: joined report blocks label translation key i18n extract). Out of scope here, correctly recorded by the dev.
4. **Sequencing with objectui#13543 — recommend merge-first, as #25701 did, with the main-red owned in advance.** What `Console Pin Gate` checks: ci.yml `console-pin` shallow-clones objectui at `.objectui-sha`, builds `@object-ui/console` against THIS tree's spec and client, then asserts dist presence, the pin stamp and spec injection. Its `if:` excludes `pull_request` and `merge_group`, so it runs only on push to `main` and the hourly schedule. It is NOT in the required set: `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` tombstones it (dropped by the #9533 ruling) and says that name must stay out of any required set, and the five queue-blocking contexts are `Lint and Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. So a red there blocks NO pull request and NO queue entry mechanically. What it does cost: (a) the release gate reads it before any approval (`scheduled-full-run.mjs --release-gate`; #25735 recorded "the release gate refuses a cut while it stays red" with a Version Packages PR open), (b) AGENTS.md's Main-red convention, which binds the spec lane: the lane's next PR fixes it and no lane PR arms the queue meanwhile, and (c) `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` files or refreshes the hourly card. Why hold does not work cleanly: objectui#13543's rows fail objectui's own `tsc` at any `.objectstack-sha` that lacks the group (TS2353 excess property under `satisfies`, measured on #13485), so the only pin that lets it land first is this branch's head; objectui's `bump-objectstack.sh` would accept it with a warning ("A WARNING, NOT A GATE"), but this repo squash-merges and reaps merged branches, so objectui would be pinned to a commit that becomes unreachable, and objectui#13543's own acceptance is written merge-first ("move `.objectstack-sha` to or past that merge"). Precedent timing: #25701 merged, the schedule run went red six minutes later, objectui#13485 merged about four hours after that, #25735 moved the pin about two and a half hours later; roughly six and a half hours of main-red, during which the release gate refused a cut. Conditions for the seat on merge-first: objectui#13543 is already filed with the full acceptance (the two production sites and, per the addendum, the two test files), so the "triage files it" step is pre-done; the seat should state on the card that the next full-battery `Console Pin Gate` red is expected and owned by objectui#13543 plus the `.objectui-sha` bump, and the spec lane arms no other PR until that bump lands. If a release cut is pending in the next hours, that is the one reason to hold instead.
5. **Checks on the head at review time.** Green: `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Spec property liveness`, the five PR-shape guards, `Check PR Size`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` aggregator. Still running: `Test Core` 1 to 8 of 8, `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, the four `Type Check` jobs and the seven remaining `Lint` jobs, so the required aggregators `Lint and Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` and `Build Core` had not concluded; the record judges the contract, and the landing still waits for those to read `success`. Skipped by design (full battery only): `Console Pin Gate`, `Temporal Conformance`, the dogfood shards, the `ui/` jobs. The PR is a draft with `mergeable_state: blocked`.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-uzjpca`
Reviewed-by: `session_01K2Tat8JEt4AhLASV4V4QWE`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

**改了什么**
报表（report）的名称和描述可以翻译了：翻译包新增 `reports` 分组（`label`、`description`），和 #25701 给岗位、权限集加的分组同一形状。`os i18n extract` 会抽出每张报表的键，`os i18n check` 计入覆盖率，运行时读报表元数据时套用翻译；组织在 Studio 里改过的报表名优先于包里的翻译（报表属于可被组织覆盖的元数据）。

**为什么改**
HotCRM 在中文界面下十张报表全是英文，而 `os i18n check` 报 100%，因为报表根本没有翻译键。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**
新增可选分组，已有翻译包不受影响。objectui 的翻译预览对分组是穷举的，必须同步改（已立卡 objectui#13543）；本 PR 一合并，main 上定时跑的 Console Pin Gate 会红，直到 objectui 那张卡落地并推进 `.objectui-sha`。回滚 = 撤销合并。

**席位意见**
内容可以合并：开发者的 Fable 独立复核两轮、席位的 Fable 契约复核都通过，CI 全绿，不在受治理路径上。合并时机请你定（已在项目线程里问你）。

**你要做的**
在项目线程里选「先不合」或「现在合并」。

## 席位核对

Seat `domain:spec#4` (#18917) · `session_01K2Tat8JEt4AhLASV4V4QWE` · head `ac2bcb0ba728` · 2026-10-25T16:53Z · verdict **ACCEPT (Tier S; landing held for the owner's sequencing choice)**.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #25788`, `Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: added`; 29 files, +823/−48; `check-governed-merges --pr 25826`: 0 of 29 paths governed, under the 3000-line threshold.
2. **Independent full review** (the owner's rule 「spec skills adr 都需要fable 完整的复核」): two rounds by an isolated Fable reviewer, both approve-with-nits, nits fixed; verdict `6399284479` on the card.
3. **Contract review of record:** PASS on this head at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, `6400225090`. The `reports` group matches the `positions` precedent at all three doors; removing `reports` from `LEGACY_OBJECT_FIRST_KEYS` is required (the only runtime reader skips any stored row carrying a listed key); the Regime O yield follows ADR-0126 §3 and ADR-0029 D9.2a through the shared predicate; changeset minor on spec, cli, lint, metadata-protocol and rest.
4. **Gates.** Head-pinned check-runs on `ac2bcb0ba728`: 48 completed, 38 success, 10 skipped, none failed. Dev `dispatch-gates --commands` 134/134 exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED.
5. **Consumer.** objectui needs the change (`TranslationPreview` `CATEGORY_DEFS` and `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS` are exhaustive over the bundle shape): child card objectui#13543 with addendum `6399274054`. Merging first turns main's scheduled Console Pin Gate red until objectui#13543 lands and `.objectui-sha` moves (precedent #25701: about 6.5 hours, and the release gate refuses a cut meanwhile). The gate is not a required context, so it blocks no PR.
6. **Accepted as is / not filed:** a joined report's `blocks[].label` has no translation key; the dev recorded it out of scope and the contract review would make it a small follow-up card. The seat files no card this shift (the owner closed the round to new work); it is listed in the clock-out brief.
7. **Landing.** Held as draft until the owner chooses: merge now (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay) or hold until objectui#13543 lands.
